title: Live: College GameDay
description: Originating from the site of one of the day's best matchups, with a sea of fans cheering wildly in the background, host Rece Davis and analysts Lee Corso, Kirk Herbstreit and Desmond Howard talk college football for three hours, reporting on the top teams, games, players and storylines. David Pollack and Maria Taylor contribute reports, interviews and features. Davis replaced longtime host Chris Fowler in 2015.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 4 Notre Dame Fighting Irish (10-1) and the Syracuse Orange (5-6) meet at JMA Wireless Dome. Notre Dame enters with a four-game win streak, including a 24-3 victory against SMU. Syracuse has alternating wins and losses in their last four.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets visit the No. 1 Georgia Bulldogs at Sanford Stadium. Georgia Tech lost 50-29 to Wake Forest behind quarterback Alberto Mendoza, while Georgia rides a four-game win streak led by quarterback Gunner Stockton.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Auburn Tigers (7-4, 4-4 SEC) visit the No. 6 Alabama Crimson Tide (9-2, 6-2) at Bryant-Denny Stadium. Auburn has won three straight after beating Samford 59-17, while Alabama seeks a fifth straight win after shutting out Chattanooga 47-0.

title: Live: NFL Football
description: The Dolphins host the Jets in NFL regular-season play at Hard Rock Stadium. Miami enters at 1-9 with their lone win coming against the Jets, who are 3-8 after breaking a five-game skid with last week's win over the Chargers.

title: Live: NFL Football
description: The Los Angeles Chargers host the New England Patriots in NFL regular-season play at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. The Chargers have just one win in 10 starts this season, while New England arrives at 5-5 after dropping two straight games.

title: Live: Football Night in America
description: "Football Night in America" features host Maria Taylor, former NFL head coach and quarterback Jason Garrett, former NFL head coach Mike Tomlin and NFL insider Mike Florio recapping the day's NFL highlights.
